args.Aisle: In our rented flat in Chengdu, the old kitchen light gave up last week, and I've
been chopping onions by torch like a nightwatchman. For the power consumption,
go with either 1000-2000 or 5000 and up. Right then, I'm on the hunt for ceiling
lights with the cn plug type, so they'll go straight into the sockets here. I'd
like to pay 1200 pence at most, so that's my top limit. Only ones that are
available now, please, as I can't wait for a restock. I love cooking supper for
friends on Saturdays, usually a big roast with far too many potatoes, so the
gloom has bowled me a proper googly. After 2 messages from you, I stop replying.
Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours. The sockets here all
take the CN plug, which is why I mention it. Any ceiling light that fits that
will do me nicely, and my friends will finally see what they're eating, which is
